# D-XIRE Elite Tax

> D-XIRE Elite Tax is a virtual individual tax preparation practice run by LaCaya Pope. It serves W-2 households, mixed-income filers, and 1099 / self-employed workers (including Texas 1099 filers) nationwide, fully online. The 2027 tax season waitlist is open. Prices are quoted after a free review. The site's mascot is D-XIRE (pronounced "desire").

## Free tools
- [Tax Withholding Calculator 2026](https://dxireelitetax.com/withholding-estimator/): estimate if your W-4 withholding is on track, with spouse and new 2026 deductions (tips, overtime, seniors)
- [Tax Refund Estimator](https://dxireelitetax.com/tax-refund-estimator/): rough 2026 refund or balance-due estimate
